import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # fix island label variants: strip spaces and normalize case (torgersen -> Torgersen, 'Dream ' -> 'Dream')
    if 'island' in df.columns:
        df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
        df.loc[df['island'] == 'Nan', 'island'] = pd.NA
    # fix body_mass_g: text numbers with commas like '3,150' -> 3150
    if 'body_mass_g' in df.columns:
        df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip()
        df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
        df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # fix flipper_length_mm: negatives and out of range (170-235)
    if 'flipper_length_mm' in df.columns:
        df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'].astype(str).str.strip(), errors='coerce')
        df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
        df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # drop missing species keys and filter to allowed species
    df = df.dropna(subset=['species'])
    allowed = ['Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo']
    df = df[df['species'].isin(allowed)]
    grouped = df.groupby('species', dropna=True)['body_mass_g'].sum(min_count=1)
    result = {}
    for k, v in grouped.items():
        if pd.isna(k):
            continue
        result[str(k)] = int(v) if not pd.isna(v) else 0
    return result
